name: Whale
description: The Winterworks whale: a massive sperm whale built from block-scale boxes in the vanilla mob style: a huge square head over a narrow toothed jaw, small dot eyes far back under a heavy brow, a flat 9-block-wide back for a block deck, a body stepping in to a pale belly, small fins and a broad fluke; wrinkly slate-grey skin with pale scars. Minecraft pixel units at density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
